text.interpretation: Historical measured expert motion, not recorded move_to commands. Do not copy historical absolute coordinates into the current scene.
text.outcome_convention: Success is the official per-episode metadata result; no checker rerun.
text.robot_convention: EE is measured panda_hand pose relative to robot base: metres then quaternion wxyz; not OpenETA world gripper-center TCP. Joint vector: seven arm radians then two finger positions in metres.
text.task_goal: Grasp the bottle resting on the ground plane and lift it vertically, keeping the bottle base within 5 cm of the wall at the final pose.
text.time_convention: Frame step values are recorded. Seconds below are nominal step differences / 120 from published collect timing, not an embedded per-frame clock.
text.unrecorded: Original actuator/tool commands and force/grasp-state labels are unavailable.
